title: Etale-origin witnesses for the two restricted relative-adjoint values
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell
e p_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $n\geq1$, and set $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $f:X	o Y$ be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and let $g:Y'\hookrightarrow Y$ be an arbitrary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $X'=X	imes_YY'$ with projections $g':X'\hookrightarrow X$ and $f':X'	o Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. On the ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories of the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], write $
u_T^*$ for exact comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $f^	imes_e,f'^	imes_e$ be the ordinary etale right adjoints for the proper identity-open compactifications, and $Rf^!,Rf'^!$ the relative exceptional functors $
u^*f_e^	imes R
u_*$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image, thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. For $K_0\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\alpha:
u_Y^*K_0\xrightarrow{\sim}K$, the two etale complexes
$$B_0=g'^{e,*}f_e^	imes K_0,\qquad C_0=f'^	imes_e g^{e,*}K_0$$
are bounded below. There are canonical isomorphisms, natural in $(K_0,\alpha)$,
$$
u_{X'}^*B_0\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^*Rf^!K,\qquad 
u_{X'}^*C_0\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'^!g^*K,$$
using the comparison adjunction unit and the canonical pullback identifications. Thus these displayed pairs give objects in the witnessed full category [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. No isomorphism between these two objects, and no unrestricted pro-etale ambient adjoint datum, is asserted here.

proof.text: A field is Noetherian because its only ideals are zero and one. Hence Y is Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. For every affine open V of Y, the open subscheme Y'\times_Y V is Noetherian and quasi-compact by [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian]. Thus g is quasi-compact by the definition of a quasi-compact morphism, and is finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-qc-open-immersion-finite-type]. Composition makes Y' finite type over k. Properness of f includes finite type and separatedness; finite-type base change makes f' finite type, and proper base change makes f' proper. Open-immersion base change makes g' open. Composing f' with Y'\to\operatorname{Spec}k also makes X' finite type over k. Choose the identity-open compactifications (id_X,f) and (id_{X'},f'). The finite-type dimension lemma gives finite dimension bounds; choose nonnegative integer bounds, using zero for an empty source. Thus [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class] applies to both compactifications and supplies the ordinary etale right adjoints.

proof.text: The bounded-below typing clause in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] gives f_e^\times K_0\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A) and f'^\times_e g^{e,*}K_0\in D^+(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A); the same clause applies to the proper map f' established in Step 1. Exact inverse image on etale module sheaves preserves cohomology bounds, by [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact] and [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below]. Thus g'^{e,*}f_e^\times K_0=B_0 and f'^\times_e g^{e,*}K_0=C_0 are bounded below, as claimed.

proof.text: By the definition of the witnessed full category [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory], a bounded-below pro-etale object together with a bounded-below etale complex and an isomorphism from its comparison pullback is an object of that full category. The two isomorphisms in Step 4 therefore give the required witnesses for g'^*Rf^!K and Rf'^!g^*K. The argument constructs witnesses for each restricted value separately; it neither identifies B_0 with C_0 nor asserts a right adjoint on arbitrary pro-etale objects.
